observations: Curse starts with partial Desert Treasure I (ring of visibility) and started Restless Ghost; Valdez gives ghostly robe top.
The three possible Valdez clues select one fixed five-ghost sequence; pieces are awarded by Rennard, Kharrim, Lennissa, Dhalak and Viggora in that order.

Sequence 1 includes wilderness pirate wreck, Chaos Temple, Entrana, Wizards' Tower and Rogues' Castle; sequence 2 uses Wilderness Bandit Camp, Graveyard of Shadows, Port Sarim, 31-Prayer Edgeville Monastery and Slayer Tower; sequence 3 uses Kharidian Bandit Camp, Lava Maze with slash knife, Gnome Stronghold, Falador Party Room and Edgeville Dungeon.
Minas gives a separately claimed 10 kudos plus 10,000-XP antique lamp for the ghostly robes history, not an automatic miniquest reward.
The General's Shadow requires Curse of Empty Lord, Fight Arena, six robes, ring, ghostspeak amulet and 40 GP for the Sin Seer note.
Khazard's four scouts at Karamja, Gnome Stronghold, Falador and Shantay Pass can be spoken to in any order.
Ghost Bouncer's final fight cannot use prayer; gives Shadow sword and 2,000 Slayer XP without quest points.
pending_reviews: Valdez chooses one of three random paths; the optimizer can branch on the observed clue but cannot select the RNG outcome. A seeded deterministic variant is not a guarantee for a live account.

The schema has a single canonical completion action waypoint; the abstract marker is anchored to Valdez even though completion occurs at Viggora. The modeled return walk is artificial and must be eliminated in a later multi-location action design.
Wilderness travel can encounter player killers and Wilderness teleport limits, not accounted for in expected timings.
Ghost dialogues require worn ring, ghostspeak amulet and robes; the catalog's item requirements check possession rather than equipped slots.
Exact NPC roam radius and interior plane coordinates, especially Wilderness pirate ship, Lava Maze, Rogues' Castle and Bouncer's instanced arena, need field verification.
Minas lamp: level 50 vs strictly above 50, whether retainable/bankable and 2026 quest reward updates require field check.
Check the 40-GP Sin Seer payment, fight attrition and optional Karamja boat fare; our route uses existing ship edges.
Replacement ghostly robes and Shadow sword are reclaimable, but only the first award is modeled to avoid duplicated rewards.
